description: This file implements an event-driven mechanism for handling file descriptor events and timers within the Android telephony RIL (Radio Interface Layer). It includes functions for initializing event structures, adding/removing events, processing timeouts, and running an event loop, with synchronization primitives and platform-specific timing utilities.

methods.name: ril_event_init
methods.description: Initializes internal data structures and synchronization primitives for event handling.

methods.name: ril_event_set
methods.description: Configures a ril_event structure with file descriptor, persistence, callback, and parameter.

methods.name: ril_event_add
methods.description: Adds an event to the watch list or timer list for monitoring.

methods.name: ril_timer_add
methods.description: Schedules a timer event with a specified timeout.

methods.name: ril_event_loop
methods.description: Runs the main event loop, waiting for events or timers and dispatching callbacks.
